{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now check the control arm, moderate severity group after deduplication
control_moderate_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

print(f"Control arm, moderate severity patients after deduplication: {len(control_moderate_dedup)}")

# Check if any have responded
responded_count = control_moderate_dedup['responded'].sum()
print(f"Number of responders in control arm, moderate severity: {responded_count}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(control_moderate_dedup)
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Output the result
fraction_responded"}
